acceptance: ADR-001 addendum recording facts-only vs introspectors and the demand criterion that admits a platform.
context:
Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan gate D-9, added after plan review F10.

Closed by PR #2634 (squash-merged 2026-10-04, merge SHA 16ceaa48fe9c821d48697df4c0846422f57fda1b): ADR-001 addendum "verification reach beyond DuckDB and ClickHouse" in docs/development/tuning-adr-001-trust-and-hash-semantics.md.

DECISION (option A, facts-only by default; owner-endorsed 2026-10-04):
- No new verdict-producing introspectors in this cycle. Existing DuckDB, ClickHouse and Snowflake introspectors stay as they are. Admitted set: {}.
- Admission criterion for a future platform, all three required: (1) its layout renders at execution (registry entry not none or :preview_only); (2) tuned runs on it are planned (a tuned corpus bundle or an open tracker item); (3) the owner approves a live confirmation run. Any introspector must be bounded (filter inside the SQL WHERE, measure truncation on the raw row count before filtering), non-raising, structured-catalog only.
- The facts-only presentation layer is deferred, not built; the support matrix shows "no introspector" for those platforms.
- tuning-verification-reach-per-platform reduces to recording this decision (admitted set {}) and fixing ClickHouse introspector truncation; that work belongs to the main workstream (pairs with tuning-nits-sweep).
